identity: Dark navy asymmetric bangs, cyan inner hair, large cyan oval eyes, black suit with white collar and cuffs stay consistent.

states.idle: Calm blink and breathing loop; seated feet remain planted.
states.running-right: Rightward face and body with alternating arm and leg cadence.
states.running-left: Leftward generated gait; preserves hairstyle identity without mirroring.
states.waving: The same screen-right attached hand raises, waves and returns.
states.jumping: Five stages rise visibly above the ground and return to the same baseline. Resting scale calibrated against jump; transition reviewed at native cell size.
states.failed: Lids lower, head slumps, eyes close, then recover; no detached effects.
states.waiting: Expectant clasped hands near chest/chin and a small head tilt ask for input.
states.running: Seated focused thinking with hand at chin or temple; no foot-running.
states.review: Inspection through lean, narrowed gaze, hand position, blink and nod.

geometry: Component extraction succeeded in every row; complete connected silhouettes, no frame clipping or copied guide marks. All frame transformations are shared within a row.
remaining: Final edge despill and encoded-atlas gates are separate mandatory steps.
